description:
The Bazecor configurator software allows you to remap any key and create up to 10 fully programmable layers for your Dygma Raise keyboard. It also allows you to create and manage superkeys, macros, and shortcuts.


Hi, everybody
We're really happy to announce 3 new features for your Dygma keyboard!
- Autoshift: TAP to get a key; HOLD it to get its shifted version. So TAP: a, HOLD: A.
- Capsword: After you press this key, only the next word will be capitalized.
- Combos: Press up to 6 keys at once to trigger a single action, like another key, a modifier, a shortcut, a macro...
To use them, you also need to update your keyboard to the latest beta firmware:
- Defy v.2.6
- Raise 2 v1.6
- Sonsei v1.2
Unfortunately, due to memory limitations, we couldn't implement these new features on the OG Raise.
But that's not all; this Bazecor release also includes several improvements to Layer Lens and some bug fixes.
What's new
- Added support for Autoshift, Capsword and Combos
- Added support for all the different language layouts to Layer Lens

Fixes and improvements
- You can now restore Sonsei backups to the Defy
- Bazecor is now available through Flathub for Linux users thanks to @mean-ui-thread
- Fixed a bug where Layer Lens could make your mouse stutter
- Fixed a bug where Bazecor could crash when you closed it with Layer Lens active
- Fixed a bug where Ctrl+Alt+L unintentionally activated Layer Lens
- Improved the wording of the bootloader pop-up
- Improved the wording of the Superkeys' settings menu
- You can now see the values of your preferences in the Settings menu
- Fixed a bug where the app update pop-up would not tell you it was for Bazecor (you'll notice this in the next release)
- Removed random delays in macros, as they were causing issues
- Removed "use only custom layers" toggle in Settings, because it should always be active
- Removed the "new neuron pop-up"; it was confusing
- No Key is now represented with a blank key for a cleaner look
- Improved the video shown on the Defy firmware update menu
